task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence with three bounded product tasks: restore readable, collision-aligned cemetery traversal; complete the ordinary five-wave/Bellkeeper route and authored upgrade-choice presentation; and make guarded dense profiling consumable by native qualification.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release-convergence candidate still has two distinct implementation gaps: authored-world collision/occlusion ownership makes the central cemetery landmark obscure the player, and the dense-profile path lacks native three-cycle qualification evidence. The ordinary route remains a required product increment but its deferred issue is not assigned for closure this loop.

stop_conditions: Keep scope to the three required gaps and the two active issue ids.
Do not replace or split the preserved authored cemetery package or automatic-combat mechanisms.
Do not claim issue closure, native qualification, or route completion; GameLoop Runtime and Tester own recapture and verdicts.

strategy.rationale: Use collision/occluder isolation instead of repeated transform tuning for the arena defect, a separate authoritative route-plus-choice pass for player-visible ordinary progression, and a guarded candidate-owned receipt contract for dense qualification. Preserve existing authored assets and automatic combat while giving each required gap one measurable implementation surface.

code: Run focused static/project checks for cemetery collision and occluder ownership, dense-profile receipt/idempotency guards, wave-director terminal transitions, and upgrade-card bindings/focus states.
Verify target-path changes do not modify preserved authored source packages, automatic-combat ownership, or unrelated product surfaces.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime should recapture camera/movement/dash coverage at spawn, critical route, central landmark, and boundary/perimeter, including before-contact, near-contact, after-departure, collision, disappearance/occlusion, and ordinary movement replay predicates.

GameLoop Runtime and Tester should execute the ordinary route in a fresh session through all five waves, Bellkeeper phases, a terminal outcome, Result, and Retry; separately open the level-up page and inspect keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus plus selected-build state.

GameLoop Runtime should run the guarded dense protocol serially for three reset-isolated native cycles and bind renderer, preflight, distributions, lifecycle, and reset receipts; Tester owns pass/fail closure of the dense gap and active camera issue.
Retain boot, clean-log, automatic-attack/hit, pickup, pause, and restart smoke checks.
visual: Capture shipped-camera gameplay frames proving larger traversable scale, external world/external depth, central building/landmark visibility, aligned collision, stable boundary/perimeter, and readable escape lanes during ordinary movement.
Capture the upgrade-draft page at gameplay resolution with silhouettes/icons, truthful compact deltas, restrained hierarchy, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.
Use representative dense gameplay frames only to check that profiling introduces no HUD, composition, or readability regression; native telemetry remains authoritative for performance qualification.

done_when: The authored cemetery remains one intact authoritative environment and the playable space is expanded to a larger traversable scale where needed, with a coherent external world and external depth beyond the playable edge.
Every prominent central building and landmark remains readable from the shipped high-angle camera before approach, near contact, and after departure during ordinary movement or movement replay.

Rendered geometry and gameplay collision agree: no pass-through, invisible barrier, player/enemy embedding, or landmark disappearance/occlusion drift; the boundary/perimeter remains aligned and non-playable outside the arena.
Focused source checks show camera-aware occlusion handling and collision layers/masks are isolated without changing automatic attacks, lantern hit resolution, or world-space enemy vitality binding.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authored-world spatial integration around the central cemetery landmark using a materially different root-cause strategy from prior camera transform tuning. Inspect the existing map, ArenaCamera, MausoleumCollision, GroundCollision, boundary, and spawn/objective owners; isolate or rebind the offending occluder and collision spaces, and add only product-owned outer datum, collision, navigation, spawn, or objective anchors needed for alignment. Preserve native streets, terrain, buildings, props, and materials. Ensure the camera exposes escape lanes and nearby threats while the external world stays non-playable.
tasks.title: Restore cemetery scale, landmark visibility, and collision

done_when: A tester-only dense profile is guarded from release exports and records deterministic per-sample distributions for frame/physics/render time, active enemies, projectiles, effects, lights, pooled actors, allocations, and runtime errors.
Three consecutive cycles can be prepared, advanced exactly once, reset, and recorded with cycle id, setup/advance generations, renderer/preflight status, reset isolation, and next-frame receipts.
Counters and pooled state are cleared on reset; ordinary release wave spawning, enemy motion fairness, automatic combat causality, and HUD behavior are unchanged when profiling is disabled.
Focused code checks validate the receipt schema, release guard, bounded sample history, and lifecycle idempotency so the host can perform native qualification.
tasks.instructions: Complete the existing candidate-owned dense-profile contract and its runtime integration. Keep sampling tied to authoritative swarm/combat lifecycle data, preserve deterministic bucket scheduling and actor pooling, and expose concise prepare/advance/reset receipts for the host's native three-cycle protocol. Do not fabricate a qualification verdict or alter ordinary balancing; retain software-renderer evidence as rejected/pending until native recapture.
tasks.title: Finish guarded dense-profile qualification receipts

done_when: The authoritative ordinary run advances through warmup, five contiguous waves with the declared composition escalation, intermissions, Bellkeeper transition, boss phases/telegraph/recovery, victory or failure, and Result/Retry lifecycle without duplicate terminal transitions or spawning after termination.

Wave 1 teaches movement, auto-attacks, collection, and the first draft; later waves add flank, ranged, elite, density, and controlled boss pressure while retaining a recoverable movement choice and live-cap/spawn-budget enforcement.

The level-up page replaces text-stacked choices with an authored visual hierarchy: each card has a weapon/upgrade silhouette or icon anchor, compact stat icons, restrained copy, and truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas; the CURRENT column never uses NEW or LOCKED placeholders and unchanged/exhaustive rows are omitted.

Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, disabled, confirm, and cancel states are visibly complete at the ordinary presentation scale, while authoritative selected id, rank, and applied modifier remain present in runtime state.
